data.subject: cmd:claim.force:B-quota-meters:
data.text:
Approve gated command 'claim.force' for agent sw-quotameters?
  command : ddflow claim <id> --approval request|ID
  item    : B-quota-meters    target: -
  acts on : the item and who holds its lease (or that it is in review)
  digest  : 68c5f4a9668cc21a  (the state is read again when the agent runs it)
  needs   : tier T2, assurance level L1 or stronger; 1 use(s)
  agent's reason (untrusted, not part of the approval): ""
  approved by standing rule: claim_unavailable

data.note: P-swarm push lane: quota meters per item body, UNAVAILABLE never zero [operator approval Q606e555f9c by policy:claim_unavailable via policy]

data.summary: The rule is documented as covering an item held by a vanished/unavailable holder, but its predicate in services/approvals/policy.py is _true. A plain agent claim of a dep-blocked item with no holder (B-quota-meters, no force, no approval passed) was refused by plan_blocker, then re-run forced by _claim_by_approval through Q606e555f9c approved by policy:claim_unavailable, human:false. The claim@1 reply carries no field saying it was forced or approved; only the lease note and ask events show it. So next says blocked, claim grants a worktree, and the agent cannot tell. Expected: the predicate requires a lapsed lease whose holder is gone, and any forced grant is stated in the claim reply.
data.title: Standing rule claim_unavailable approves any claim.force, so a plain claim silently passes unmet dependencies

A plain agent claim of a dep-blocked item with no holder (B-quota-meters, no force, no approval passed) was refused by plan_blocker, then re-run forced by _claim_by_approval through Q606e555f9c approved by policy:claim_unavailable, human:false. The claim@1 reply carries no field saying it was forced or approved; only the lease note and ask events show it. So next says blocked, claim grants a worktree, and the agent cannot tell. Expected: the predicate requires a lapsed lease whose holder is gone, and any forced grant is stated in the claim reply. Found on B-quota-meters.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B-claim-unavailable-fires-past-deps --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B-claim-unavailable-fires-past-deps --regression-test <test>` first).
